items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We later on got to be friends, and I used to rib him about this all the time.

ctx.x: It was one of the first ones. Bob MacDonald was the guy‟s name. We later on got to be friends, and I used to rib him about this all the time. He turned me down.
So then what did you do? You got refused or rejected by L.A. City College.
